title: Application of Western Masachusetts Electric Company, under the provisions of G .L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company 's tariff, M.D.P.U. 524 for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly fuel charge to be billed to Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billling months of March, April and May, 1988. Application is also made by Western Massachusetts Electric Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchase of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U. 586. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the fillings to be made by utilitiies with the Department and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
